atlas_fit.current_problem: Text-only retrieval loses charts, tables, layout, and other visual evidence.
atlas_fit.future_risk: Screenshot indexes are storage-intensive, can contain protected visual data, and may retrieve appearance without semantic correctness.

claims.claim: The repository documents rendering documents into screenshot tiles and retrieving over images to preserve visual structure, with an Apache-2.0 codebase and research paper.
Hosted-index benchmarks and visual retrieval quality generalize to Atlas documents and privacy needs.

excluded_classes: raw financial, legal, tax, insurance, mortgage, estate, brokerage, or account evidence
